Theme ORE

theme_ore.Rd

A ggplot2::ggplot2 theme for the CCPS Office of Research and Evaluation

Usage

theme_ore(
  size = 12,
  base_font = "sans",
  base_color = "grey20",
  accent_color = "grey40",
  faceted = FALSE
)

Arguments

size

Numeric. Base font size. Default is 12.

base_font

Character. Base font family. Default is 'sans'

base_color

Character. Color of text and ticks. Default is 'grey20'

accent_color

Character. Color of grid lines. Default is 'grey40'.

faceted

Logical. TRUE will reduce margins to make faceted subplots larger

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# basic scatterplot
ggplot(mtcars, aes(mpg, wt)) +
    geom_point() +
    labs(
        x = "miles per gallon",
        y = "weight",
        title = "Scatterplot example",
        subtitle = "this is a subtitle",
        caption = "by bret bretterson"
    ) +
    theme_ore()
} # }
